scope: Separate the primary ARB oracle-utility claim from the secondary ARB-versus-legacy representation/fusion claim. This amendment does not authorize a hot update, R4-B, test access, M4, M5 or B-core.

original_gate.immutability_rule: The original gate and its decision for the already-started run remain unchanged and auditable. This amendment must never be represented as having been frozen before the inspected R4-A results.

epistemic_boundary.known_when_amended: Partial train/tune branch results from the original R4-A run had already been inspected; no test path had been opened.
epistemic_boundary.reason: The original control_rule conflated two distinct claims: whether correct action-relevant team state improves action prediction, and whether the proposed ARB representation/fusion outperforms a stronger privileged legacy B interface. The R4 legacy condition also used a frozen-HC residual path rather than the from-scratch concat model that failed in M3-R3.
epistemic_boundary.classification: post-result protocol correction with mandatory fresh confirmation
epistemic_boundary.anti_p_hacking_rule: The revised primary pass may not be assigned from the already-inspected tune results alone.

claim_split.primary: Correct oracle ARB content provides incremental action-predictive information beyond frozen HC and matched-capacity/content-destroyed controls.
claim_split.secondary: Under matched information hygiene, normalization, fusion capacity and training protocol, ARB is superior to a sanitized legacy B representation and/or query attention is superior to direct residual fusion.
non_claims: ARB is observable from legal deployment inputs
ARB is causally necessary for cooperation
ARB is universally better than entity-resolved team state
raw privileged legacy B is a fair replacement gate for ARB

r4_a1_primary_oracle_utility.role: blocking gate for authorization to begin R4-B

acceptance.seed_direction_rule: at least two of three oracle seeds have positive macro gain and no seed has a 95% CI entirely at or below -3%
acceptance.required_control_rule: oracle ARB must have a positive paired 95% CI lower bound versus zero residual, input-independent noise residual, label-shuffled ARB and episode-shuffled ARB
acceptance.aggregation: per-episode median error over three frozen seeds, followed by at least 10000 task-stratified paired episode bootstrap resamples

legacy_reference_rule.reporting: Report point estimate, task-level effects, seed-level effects and paired confidence interval against oracle ARB, but do not use it to pass or fail oracle utility.
legacy_reference_rule.reason: It contains a different and stronger privileged information set and therefore tests representation replacement, not the existence of ARB utility.

r4_a2_standardized_2x2.role: secondary claim gate; non-blocking for R4-B authorization

information_axis.raw_legacy_B: Report separately as a privileged-information upper-bound diagnostic; it is not a fair 2x2 cell and is non-blocking.

fusion_axis.shared_fallback: frozen HC plus a zero-initialized residual that modifies only the first 16 future action steps

shared: optimizer, learning-rate policy and convergence rule
fairness_constraints.input_preprocessing: Fit normalization or standardization from train only and apply the frozen transform to every cell.
fairness_constraints.parameter_matching: Freeze exact adapter widths before confirmation so trainable parameter counts differ by no more than 5% between cells; otherwise add a matched-capacity control and mark the 2x2 inconclusive.
fairness_constraints.no_hidden_paths: No cell may receive raw legacy B, P, T, progress, identity or future information through another input path.

registered_contrasts.representation_main_effect: ARB versus sanitized legacy B, averaged over the two frozen fusion levels
registered_contrasts.fusion_main_effect: query attention versus direct residual MLP, averaged over the two frozen information levels
registered_contrasts.interaction: difference of the two fusion effects; always report even when neither main effect passes

secondary_acceptance.arb_representation_superiority: positive paired 95% CI lower bound for the registered ARB representation main effect
secondary_acceptance.query_fusion_superiority: positive paired 95% CI lower bound for the registered query-attention fusion main effect
secondary_acceptance.failure_effect: Failure blocks only the corresponding superiority/replacement claim; it does not reverse a separately confirmed A1 oracle-utility pass.

required_actions: Allow the original run to finish without code, condition, seed, metric or acceptance changes.
Issue the original frozen-gate decision, including the legacy comparison.
If HC, zero and noise checks pass, additionally record SUPPORTED_ORACLE_UTILITY_UNDER_ORIGINAL_CONTROL_SET as a post-result scientific classification, not as the confirmed A1 pass.
Keep R4-B and every test path locked.

before_execution: Create a successor executable gate with an immutable hash.
Freeze fresh initialization, sampler, shuffle and statistics seeds that were not selected from the inspected results.
Freeze a new non-overlapping confirmation validation set or equivalent untouched confirmation episodes; the existing inspected tune set cannot be the sole confirmation evidence.
Freeze implementations for label-shuffled ARB, episode-shuffled ARB and all four standardized 2x2 cells.
Freeze exact trainable parameter counts and train-only preprocessing statistics.
Use a new run root; do not resume or overwrite the original run.
fresh_confirmation_requirements.test_rule: The formal read-only test remains sealed. A1 and R4-B must pass before the existing R4-C authorization sequence can be reconsidered.

authorization_after_confirmation.r4_b: Only PASSED_M3_R4_A1_CONFIRMED_ORACLE_UTILITY may authorize R4-B. The A2 2x2 outcome is reported but non-blocking.
authorization_after_confirmation.r4_c: Only a subsequent R4-B pass may authorize one sealed test evaluation.
authorization_after_confirmation.b_core: R4 never directly unlocks B-core; M4 and M5 must also pass.
